sections.heading: Type power
lines: Electric moves are 2× stronger.
Water moves are 1.5× stronger.
Fire moves fail.
Dragon Darts and Grav Apple also count as Water for type matchups.
Ground moves also count as Water for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Anchor Shot and Dragon Darts: 2× stronger.
Jet Punch and Water Pulse: 1.5× stronger.
Spicy Extract and Tar Shot: no effect here.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Water-type.
Nature Power becomes Water Pulse.
Secret Power can lower the target's Attack.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Acid Downpour and Sludge Wave change the field into Murkwater Surface once their uses add up to 2 (Acid Downpour 2 and Sludge Wave 1).
Bounce, Dive, Fly, Shore Up, Sky Drop, and Triple Dive change the field into Water Surface.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Propeller Tail: 1.5× damage.
Torrent: 1.5× power for Water-type moves.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Dry Skin or Water Absorb restores 1/16 of its HP.
Steam Engine: Speed +1.
Water Compaction: Defense +2.

sections.heading: Weather and status
lines: Weather cannot be started here.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Speed +1 and becomes Water-type.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
